title: 1290 Super Adventure S (Chrome Edition)
description: Tailored for Highway asphalt, the KTM 1290 Super Adventure S (Chrome Edition) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. An aggressive Aggressive Forward Tuck layout places rider weight decisively over the front axle with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, maximizing cornering feedback at apex speeds.
